sources.scope: Only the four selected rules sections listed by source keys in config/identities.json; not blanket clearance of the wiki.
sources.review: Wiki declares applicable non-Product-Identity rules Open Game Content. These selected feat, gear and base-class rules contain no copied artwork, maps, named setting characters or setting narrative. Preserve the complete published OGL text and copyright-notice list. Incanter and Extra Magic Talent use the Ultimate tab; equipment uses its current rules section. Other collections remain unreviewed. Favorite Tools uses the current Artifice skill-talent section from Spheres of Guile. The retained notice list includes Spheres of Guile (2023).
